capture_program: capture_kiln_workflow_slots.rs in the evidence directory of the Kiln change show-workflow-revisions-in-cairn-workspace, added as tests/capture_kiln_workflow_slots.rs to a detached worktree of the Lattice commit and nowhere else
command: KILN_WORKFLOW_SLOTS_CAPTURE_DIR=$DIR nix develop . --option builders '' -c cargo test --locked --test capture_kiln_workflow_slots -- --test-threads 1
lifecycle: Lattice's own composition (agent_revision::composite::compose of a compiled lattice::workflow::intent plan with a resolved worker bundle), the desire transition desire-workflow applies after composition, prepare and promote through agent_revision::run_command_with_ports with the FixturePreparation and FixtureQualification ports, and seam::admit / seam::close for two sessions; the inputs are the synthetic request and intent of tests/test_agent_revision_shell.rs
read_back: the outcome.workflow_slots member of the `lattice agent-revision inspect --store STORE --definition DEFINITION` binary output after each step, re-encoded by serde_json pretty printing (sorted keys, trailing newline)

scenarios.workflow-2-promoted.json: R1 prepared and promoted for new sessions (rollout generation 1)
scenarios.workflow-4-second-revision.json: R2 (new guidance, worker with a changed executable) desired, prepared and promoted (rollout generation 2); session-b pinned to R2, live; session-a on R1 closed and blocked
